en.askTitle: Put in your own family, salary and workplace and get a first-rental plan for Metro Vancouver
en.runTitle: Manila family of three to Vancouver: a two-bedroom near SkyTrain on a CAD 82,000 salary

fields.label: Adults, child ages or birthdays, immigration status
fields.value: Two adults and a 4-year-old; new permanent residents

fields.label: Gross salary, payroll estimate and accessible savings
fields.value: Job offer of CAD 82,000 a year

fields.label: Care coverage, provider quotes, debts and other obligations
fields.placeholder: e.g. no care help yet, one daycare quote of CAD 800 a month, no debts

en.template: Plan our first Metro Vancouver rental for {family}, arriving {date} from {city}, with {salary}. Use {workplace} to compare station corridors and actual two-bedroom housing costs. Model {care}, count no benefit until eligibility and amount are established, and separate monthly spending, landing cash and emergency runway. Flag deposit/privacy/scam risks, child-care vacancies and the MSP/private-insurance gap. Keep dated examples distinct from confirmed quotes. Plan only; do not contact anyone, apply, create accounts, book or pay.

phases.title: Check live listings, commute options and the official rules and costs
phases.note: Rental pages, BC tenancy rules, childcare programmes, newcomer scam warnings
phases.judgment: It checked childcare against the official rules instead of repeating a headline figure: the fee reduction for ages 3 to kindergarten is up to $545 a month for group care, and the separate benefit of about $550 is a maximum with its own eligibility tests, so nothing was counted as guaranteed. It also noticed a fee schedule that ends in April 2027, just before the family arrives.

phases.title: Write the practical guide and the source log
phases.note: Areas, listings, tenancy rules, first-month cash, monthly budget
phases.judgment: It did not hide the hard part: take-home pay is estimated at $5,210 a month on a labelled 2026 tax-year proxy, and the guide says paid childcare can push a one-income budget into deficit.

phases.title: Check completeness, figures, links and how the page renders
phases.judgment: The independent reviewer recomputed the budget and found it all matched. It also checked that listings with no floor area say “Size not stated” rather than a guessed size, and advised against inferring sizes.

workers: Found current two-bedroom rental listings near SkyTrain in Burnaby, New Westminster, Surrey, East Vancouver and Coquitlam, and opened each page
Read the official BC tenancy rules, the rent-increase limit, and ChildCare BC fees and funding
Independently checked the guide against the original listing pages and recomputed the budget
